_meta.purpose: BIS mandatory-certification products dataset for the AI assistant (SIH Problem Statement 26107)
_meta.source: Compiled directly from official bis.gov.in pages: Scheme-I (ISI Mark Scheme) and Scheme-II (Registration Scheme), fetched live and verified.
_meta.note: This dataset now covers TWO tiers: (1) ALL products under MANDATORY BIS certification across Scheme I (ISI), Scheme II (CRS), Scheme IV (CoC), Scheme X (switchgear/machinery), and Hallmarking; (2) a large set of VOLUNTARY products eligible for fast-tracked ISI certification under Option-2/Simplified Procedure, sourced from BIS's official 'List of Products Under Simplified Procedure'. It still does not cover the FULL ~20,000+ Indian Standards catalog. Note: FMCS is NOT a separate product list - it is a licensing route (for foreign manufacturers) applicable to any product with an Indian Standard, except Electronics/IT (which use CRS instead).

schemes.ISI: Scheme I - Mandatory factory inspection + license (Standard Mark).
schemes.CRS: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme. Self-declaration + lab test report, no factory inspection.
schemes.Scheme-IV: Scheme IV - Certificate of Conformity (no ongoing factory license required, unlike Scheme I). Currently covers only 2 products: transformer cores and bicycle retro-reflectors.
schemes.Scheme-X: Scheme X - Certification scheme for select machinery/electrical equipment (Ministry of Heavy Industries) and switchgear/controlgear.
schemes.Hallmarking: Purity certification scheme for gold and silver jewellery/artefacts.
schemes.Voluntary-ISI: Voluntary ISI Mark certification, fast-tracked under Option-2 (Simplified Procedure) for MSMEs/domestic industry - 30-day license grant target.

Grant of license and ISI mark usage rights
CRS: Identify applicable IS/IEC standard for the product
Get product tested at a BIS-recognized/NABL-accredited lab (report valid 90 days)
Submit self-declaration + test report via CRS portal (crsbis.in)
Affix BIS Standard Mark with R-number on product
Hallmarking: Register as a jeweller with BIS
Get jewellery tested and hallmarked at a BIS-recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centre
Hallmark stamped includes BIS mark, purity grade, AHC mark, and unique HUID number
Scheme-X: Identify the applicable IS/IEC standard and specific clause for the product
Ensure manufacturing/testing infrastructure meets the product manual requirements
Apply for license via Manak Online under Scheme-X of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018
Undergo factory assessment and product testing as specified in product-specific guidelines
Grant of license and Standard Mark usage rights
Scheme-IV: Confirm product meets the essential requirement specified in the relevant QCO
Apply for Certificate of Conformity (CoC) via Manak Online under Scheme-IV
Submit test report demonstrating conformity to the applicable IS clause
Grant of Certificate of Conformity (does not require ongoing factory license like Scheme-I)
Renewal as specified in the CoC terms
Voluntary-ISI: Identify the applicable Indian Standard for the product
Apply online via BIS Manak Online portal under Option-2 (Simplified Procedure)
Submit test report from an in-house or BIS-recognized/independent lab (not older than 1 month if under Simplified Procedure)
BIS processes the application with a target of 30 days for grant of license
Grant of ISI license and Standard Mark usage rights
